create or alter function [dbo].[GetCombinedPermissions] ( @permissions dbo.Ids readonly ) returns int as begin declare @combinedPermissionMask int = 0;
select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 0, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 0) = 1) -- Read (1) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 1, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 1) = 1) -- Add (2) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 2, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 2) = 1) -- Delete (4) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 3, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 3) = 1) -- Edit (8)
select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 5, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 5) = 1) -- Read (32) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 6, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 6) = 1) -- Add (64) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 7, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 7) = 1) -- Delete (128) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 8, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 8) = 1) -- Edit (256)
select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 10, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 5) = 1) -- Read (1024) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 11, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 6) = 1) -- Add (2048) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 12, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 7) = 1) -- Delete (4096) select @combinedPermissionMask = set_bit(@combinedPermissionMask, 13, 1) from @permissions where (get_bit(Id, 8) = 1) -- Edit (8192)
return @combinedPermissionMask end
